**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go), in `internal/filter` — env/schema `internal/filter/schema.go:88,232`, compiler `internal/filter/engine.go:48,74`, IR `internal/filter/ir.go`, SQL renderer `internal/filter/render.go`. Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled into a dialect-neutral condition tree, then rendered per dialect (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL`, `internal/filter/schema.go:11-14`) into a WHERE fragment plus bind args by `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`), which each driver calls in `ListMemos` (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-62`).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus its comment memos), `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment`. `memo_share` is removed only by the DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:107`) — not by explicit code, and on SQLite that FK does not fire because foreign keys are disabled (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`, `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`) but never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `dist/` is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21,41-61`; wired in `server/server.go:72` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go: RunOnce at startup (server/server.go:163) then a 12h time.Ticker loop (runner.go:27-30), started at server/server.go:162-171
```
That is the only background runner started. Note: `server/runner/memopayload` is **not** started as a background runner — its `RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`); its `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) has no caller. And the cron scheduling package `internal/scheduler` (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`) is **unused by the server** — referenced only from its own tests/docs.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:149-183`, installed on the Connect transport at `web/src/connect.ts:182-187`. Tokens: a short-lived JWT access token kept in `localStorage` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (`web/src/auth-state.ts:52-95`, `connect.ts:96-99`), refreshed via `AuthService.RefreshToken` using the long-lived refresh token held in the HttpOnly cookie `memos_refresh` (`web/src/connect.ts:65-89`; `server/auth/token.go:39-49`); personal access tokens (`memos_pat_`) are also accepted server-side (`server/auth/token.go:52`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`), used by both the gateway middleware and Connect auth interceptor via `NewAuthorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68`, `authz.go`).

**q30.**
```

memo updated:          DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook          — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)

memo comment created:  DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook   — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go)
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` and `:120`.
